Respect the question's exact measure, entity, period, and currency. Cash paid or received,

an omission does not. Apply this explicit-zero rule only to the measure and period in the question.

That includes €25.24 billion for disbursement under the Ukraine Support Loan, consisting of €12.54 billion to support Ukraine's defence industrial capacity and €12.7 billion in budget support.
